purpose: Locate harmful wrist-y mean formation without treating final-policy counterfactual returns as historical PPO advantages.

interpretation_rule.A: large +y receives favorable on-policy raw advantage
interpretation_rule.B: raw credit is materially altered by global advantage normalization
interpretation_rule.C: credit opposes +y but a specific PPO update raises fixed-probe mu_y
interpretation_rule.D: many small updates accumulate the bias without a single discontinuity
